result.rationale: The diff replaces `afterModel` returning the findMembers promise (whose rejection would propagate to the router's error handling) with a bare fire-and-forget `model.findMembers();` in setupController. Since findMembers only sets `members` inside its `.then`, an AJAX failure leaves `members` unset, rendering an empty members table with no error surfaced — a real regression in error handling introduced by this diff, in both admin_group_route.js and group-members.js.es6.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `afterModel` hook in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6` that previously `return`ed `model.findMembers()` (so Ember would wait on the promise and route-level error handling could apply). It now calls `model.findMembers();` inside `setupController` without returning/handling the promise. Since `findMembers` performs an AJAX request and populates `members` asynchronously, a failure will not block the transition and will leave `members` unset (the template was also changed to iterate `{{#each m in members}}`), resulting in an empty members list with no user-visible error handling in this code path.
